9.o: Han Gyeol and her siblings feel suspicious of Bok Nyu and suspect that she might be the reincarnation of their mom. So, they try to do the ghost test. Meanwhile, after getting dumped by Sang Chul, Song Hwa comes to Han Gyeol's school to meet with her. Song Hwa tells Han Gyeol that she still wants to be with Sang Chul and asks Han Gyeol if she would accept Song Hwa becoming a mother for her and her siblings.

10.o: After Bok Nyu tells Sang Chul's family about her past, she quits working for his family as a housekeeper as promised. Sang Chul visits Bok Nyu and asks her if his family can be her reason to live. Meanwhile, Do Hyung offers Sang Chul a job at his company. Sang Chul accepts the offer and happens to work together with Song Hwa again.

11.o: Do Hyung invites Sang Chul and Song Hwa to his house for dinner. Sang Chul and Song Hwa are surprised to see an unexpected person at Do Hyung's house. Han Gyeol sees her father leaving Do Hyung's house with Song Hwa, and has suspicions again about their relationship. Meanwhile, Woo Jae accidentally sees Bok Nyu going to Do Hyung's house with an oil container and calls Han Gyeol to tell her about it.

12.o: Hye Gyeol tells Bok Nyu she wants to help her with anything in the kitchen. While helping Bok Nyu to make cookies, Hye Gyeol burns her hands in the oven. Bok Nyu is frightened and runs to the hospital carrying Hye Gyeol, even forgetting to wear her shoes. Meanwhile, Do Hyung tells Sang Chul that he wants to make Bok Nyu smile and asks Sang Chul for help.

13.o: Sang Chul's children ask Bok Nyu to be a mom to them. Song Hwa brings Sang Chul to her house because he passed out from being drunk. Song Hwa calls Bok Nyu and tells her to come to pick up Sang Chul because he is in her place and to make Bok Nyu see her with him. Meanwhile, Han Gyeol asks Bok Nyu to find out why Song Hwa cannot be a mother to her.

14.o: Han Gyeol and Woo Jae find out that Soo Hyuk works at a bar. So Han Gyeol asks her aunt, Na Young, to take Soo Hyuk out of the bar. Meanwhile, Bok Nyu asks Song Hwa to dig up on CEO Jang Do Hyung. Song Hwa asks Bok Nyu what kind of person Seo Ji Hoon is and Bok Nyu tells her about what Seo Ji Hoon did to her in the past.

15.o: Bok Nyu tells Song Hwa that she knows that Jang Do Hyung is Seo Ji Hoon. Bok Nyu also asks Song Hwa to do as Jang Do Hyung asks and to be careful with him. Meanwhile, Sang Chul tries to stop Do Hyung from having a relationship with Bok Nyu. Song Hwa then tries to turn Sang Chul's interest in Do Hyung to her by telling him she was involved in Sang Chul's wife, Sun Young's death.

16.o: Bok Nyu accepts Do Hyung's proposal and decides to marry him. Sang Chul and his children are worried about Bok Nyu getting married to Do Hyung. Meanwhile, Hye Gyeol doesn't want to lose Bok Nyu, so she goes to Do Hyung's house alone and tries to negotiate with him about Bok Nyu. Bok Nyu fears that Do Hyung will do something to Hye Gyeol when she sees Hye Gyeol start to become fond of Do Hyung.

17.o: Sang Chul learns that Bok Nyu is planning to quit being a housekeeper and is planning to reveal that Do Hyung is Seo Ji Hoon. Then Sang Chul visits Song Hwa, who is leaving Korea, to ask for her help. Meanwhile, Bok Nyu goes on a vacation trip with Do Hyung. On vacation, Bok Nyu tells Do Hyung that she knows that Detective Lee Tae Sik is associated with Do Hyung.

18.o: Sang Chul throws himself to save Bok Nyu from Do Hyung. Sang Chul's children visit Bok Nyu, who is hospitalized, but she is gone. Meanwhile, Director Hong Bun Nam and Geum Chi meet Bok Nyu's mother-in-law and request her to apologize to Bok Nyu so that she can smile again. Bok Nyu's mother-in-law allows Bok Nyu to smile again.

19.o: Na Young meets Bok Nyu and tells her that she doesn't like Bok Nyu and for her to not to be the mother to Sang Chul's children. Meanwhile, Sang Chul's children forget their mother Sun Young's birthday and wait for Bok Nyu to return. Na Young is disappointed when the children don't seem to care about her and her sister Sun Young. Na Young suddenly decides to get married, saying she will live her own life now.

20.o: Bok Nyu asks Sang Chul's children to choose between her and their mother. After hearing their honest feelings about their late mother, Bok Nyu decides to leave Sang Chul's family. Sang Chul and his children try to make Bok Nyu smile one last time before she leaves. Meanwhile, Hye Gyeol goes missing on the day Bok Nyu leaves.

1.o: Having avoided the closure of Otonokizaka High, the members of μ’s return to their everyday lives. News of a second Love Live reaches the girls. This time teams that win their regional preliminaries move onto the finals.

2.o: Once again μ's begins pursuing the Love Live. Just as they're getting started, a new rule is announced declaring only previously unperformed songs can be sung at the regional preliminaries. In order to write a new song in just under a month, the girls head to the mountains on a camping trip! Naturally, they stay at Maki's cabin.

3.o: The Love Live regional preliminaries are just before the girls. Because the group is free to choose any location for their performance, Honoka suggests they perform at school, but Nico and Hanayo insist they cannot win unless they choose a location with greater impact.

4.o: μ's makes it through the regional preliminaries. Learning their rivals A-RISE have made it through as well, the girls become even more fired up. Meanwhile, for some reason Nico begins skipping practice. Suspicious of her actions, the girls follow Nico to a supermarket where they witness her shopping for groceries.

5.o: While the second years are away on their school trip, Rin is selected to be the temporary leader. However, instead of living up to the members' recommendations, Rin seems unenthusastic and bewildered. When her opinion as the leader is demanded over a trivial disagreement during practice, she is unable to handle the situation.

6.o: μ's is invited to perform as a guest at the Akihabara Halloween event. They need local support to win the Love Live. By putting on a impressive performance, μ's hopes to close the gap between themselves and A-RISE before the final preliminaries.

7.o: A physical examination reveals Honoka has gained weight. Umi scolds her for her carelessness, and when she attempts to put on the outfit from the first concert...

8.o: When μ’s has trouble agreeing on a song for the final preliminaries, Nozomi suggests writing a love song. The members are shaken by the idea of performing and unfamiliar genre, but Eli is suprisingly supportive.

9.o: The day of the final preliminaries, the second years try to make their way to the event after giving an address from the student council at the school's information session, but their means of transportation are paralyzed due to the snow. The girls try walking through the snow to reach the event, but...

10.o: On their first shrine visit of the year, Honoka and her friends run into A-RISE, who give them words of encouragement for the Love Live. Yes, µ's had won the Tokyo regional final preliminaries. Teams participating in the event can post a catch phrase on their team introduction page.

11.o: When Yukiho and Alisa are accepted into Otonokizaka High, the girls discuss the future of μ’s. Nico says idols keep their name even after losing members, but Hanayo says it's not μ’s without all nine members.

12.o: When the Love Live ends, so will μ's. The day before the event, the members reach a unanimous decision. As usual, the girls gather on the roof and end their practice amidst a friendly atmosphere, but when they realize it's their last practice together, they find themselves unable to go home and end up spending their last night together at school at Honoka's suggestion.

13.o: Today is graduation. Having finally finished her farewell address, Honoka heads to school in high spirits. At the gates she meets Rin and her friends. They head to the club room together, where they find a trophy and flag.

1.o: The day begins with a routine set of exercise with the Auto Club for Keiichi. Afterwards he goes to catch a little more sleep, and ends up nearly being late for school. When he goes to get his bike, it won't start, so he has to run to school.

2.t: Ah! People Who Believe Are Saved?
2.o: Keiichi makes his wish that Belldandy will stay with him forever, and it becomes true! And it can't be undone; the wish has been registered with the system. Keiichi ponders what to do now, but his senpais Tamiya and Otaki arrive and find that he's broken the rules about having girls in the all-guys dorm. What will happen to Keiichi and Belldandy now?

3.t: Ah! Apprenticeship, My Home and a Goddess
3.o: Keiichi and Belldandy search for a place to live, trying out real estate apartment listings, his friends' apartments, and eventually a fairly worn down temple where a monk lets them in.

4.t: Ah! The Queen and the Goddess
4.o: Keiichi takes Belldandy to his school, and all the classmates are impressed by the new girl. Sayoko, the popular girl on campus, meets Belldandy and tries to figure out where she came from.

5.o: Keiichi left his books and papers at home, so Belldandy goes back to get it. As Keiichi is left alone at school, Sayoko challenges him to stop acting like he's in elementary school with that relationship. Keiichi struggles on what to say to Belldandy. He sets up a romantic mood at home with candles and all. Will that do the trick? Or will it be written off as another coincidence?

6.o: A young woman shows up at the temple where Keiichi is staying. It turns out to be Keiichi's sister Megumi, who is in town looking for apartment housing. Keiichi and Belldandy help Megumi find a place, but it has a dark secret.

7.t: Ah! The Place to Express Your Feelings
7.o: Belldandy learns about Valentine's day in Japan. Sayoko tries to set Belldandy up with the campus playboy Toshiyuki Aoshima. This could be trouble!

8.t: Ah! Taking an Examination of Love, Starting with a Deviation Value of 30
8.o: Keiichi gets a video from a store, but when he plays it, a mysterious woman shows on the screen. The woman is Urd, who is Belldandy's older sister. Urd tries to move Keiichi's romantic intentions forward by slipping him a controlling love potion.

9.t: Ah! The Secret of the Queen and the Goddess
9.o: Belldandy wins the Miss NIT contest and becomes Campus Queen. Sayoko and Toshiyuki try to uncover Belldandy's identity by setting up revealing situations where Belldandy would have to use her magic, but with big sister Urd watching, that isn't so easily done.

10.t: Ah! Can the Motor Club Win?
10.o: The Nekomi Motor Club is recruiting new members, but now there's a new rival club called Four Wheels that was started by Toshiyuki. The motor clubs have a challenge race over who gets to keep their club around.

11.t: Ah! A Devil Comes and Bestows Misfortune?
11.o: Tamiya and Otaki buy a strange Demons CD from a store. Not only is the music strange, but a spirit shoots out of the CD and asks what wish they want.

12.t: Ah! Put the Goddess and Queen on a Balance?
12.o: Marller offers Sayoko a plan to get Belldandy out of the way. Sayoko tricks Urd and steals the Demons CD. Marller casts a spell to tip Keiichi's heart balance so that Keiichi becomes fixated on Sayoko. After Belldandy goes home feeling strange, Sayoko is alone with Keiichi. This is her big chance, but what are all these suggestions Keiichi has?

13.t: Ah! Who Does Big Sister Belong To?
13.o: When Heaven's main computer, Yggdrassil, crashes due to an infestation of "bugs," a lone Goddess determines that she needs the help of her big sister... Belldandy!

14.t: Ah! A Teaching Practice Called Showdown?
14.o: Skuld's been spending a lot of time with Belldandy, but Belldandy still wants to go to school with Keiichi. Skuld decides to take apart Keiichi's bike, but ends up upgrading it. Megumi notices the upgrades and starts to critique it. This upsets Skuld, who issues Megumi a mechanic's challenge. At the suggestion of Keiichi's senpai, Skuld and Megumi enter a robot battle contest to settle their conflicts.

15.o: Skuld reveals her latest invention: Banpei RX. Banpei is a robot designed to protect Belldandy, which he does easily as Marller shows up for an attack. But that also means protecting her from Keiichi and Urd and draining tons of power from the house. Can Skuld teach Banpei to play nice? And what will they do when Marller launches another attack?

16.t: Ah! Catastrophe Comes with Rise of an Auspicious Sign?
16.o: Marller's attacks on the goddesses keep failing so she goes for a new target: Megumi! She takes over Megumi's body, and solicits the help of Senbee, the God of Poverty and generally bad luck spirit.

17.t: Ah! What Are Talent and Hard Work?
17.o: Club member Sora is entered into an all-girls racing event. Belldandy and the gang help her overcome her fears of driving and of messing up everything.

18.t: Ah! Confess Your Love Under the Moon?
18.o: Megumi gives Keiichi some tickets to a beach resort. Keiichi and Belldandy go, but the sisters tag along as well. Urd tells Keiichi there's an island spot where if he confesses it will be true love. Keiichi tries to take Belldandy to that remote island location, but Skuld has other plans.

19.t: Ah! Don't Gaze at Me with Those Eyes?
19.o: Urd makes a love candy for Keiichi, but Skuld suspects something and slips in some additional ingredients. Belldandy consumes it, and she becomes very romantically bold in all her actions and with Keiichi too!

20.t: Ah! Save the Goddess, If You're a Man?!
20.o: Urd and Skuld leave to do some work back at heaven. Skuld has Keiichi eat some flan which transforms Keiichi into a woman. Now he'll keep his hands off Belldandy, right?

21.t: Ah! The One I Yearn for Is a White-Winged Angel!
21.o: Skuld admires Belldandy's angel and wants to have one as well. Skuld tries training her skills with inventions. Then something outside threatens the girls and it's up to Urd to summon her angel, but it's revealed that Urd can't because she told her angel earlier to never come out ever again. What will the goddesses do?

22.t: Ah! A Devil's Whisper, Along with a Pot?
22.o: Marller retrieves a demonic urn from a cave. Urd's goddess license had been suspended, which motivates her to look for a regular job. But when things go bad there she accepts her demonic heritage and transforms into the Lord of Terror! Big trouble for Keiichi and the gals!

23.t: Ah! The Savior of the World Arrives with the Sound of the Flute?
23.o: The Yggdrasil system is in chaos from all the attacks from the Lord of Terror. Urd starts releasing the Ultimate Destruction Program which will not only destroy the current world but allow the demons to rule it. Belldandy decides to release her sealed power and confront Urd. God gives Skuld a Midgard Flute as a last-chance vaccine to stop the Lord of Terror. Will those efforts be enough?

24.o: It's the final showdown where the goddesses, Belldandy and Skuld, battle against the Lord of Terror, who has now possessed Midgard! With the whole world at stake, what can Keiichi do to help?

1.o: The passengers wake up on board the Origin, abandoned in space. They search for other survivors, but find something else entirely.

2.o: A tense showdown prompts a difficult decision. Shun and Lana realise that the threat could be nearer than any of them thought.

3.o: A survivor’s life hangs in the balance – and they hold the key. A new discovery threatens to tear the group apart.

4.o: Weakness leads to danger, as our passengers truly begin to understand what they’re up against. But who can they trust?

5.o: An object from Earth threatens to blow SIREN’s mission wide open, while suspicion boils over into full blown paranoia.

6.o: An unexpected find prompts a life or death dilemma, while reminders of home lead to a brutal revelation.

7.o: The stakes are raised when the ship takes control, and our passengers are forced to attempt the impossible.

8.o: Tension and paranoia abounds in the wake of a shocking discovery. Anyone could be a suspect.

9.o: A surprise visitor threatens to plunge the ship into chaos. Drastic measures are taken, but death continues to haunt the Origin.

10.o: A chilling revelation changes everything, while SIREN itself is called into question.

1.o: Undeterred by warnings, doctors Lúcia, Damião and Enzo travel to isolated Aguazul with a Zika vaccine. But no one is ready for the passionate pushback.

2.o: After Mateus’s shocking act, Damião follows a mysterious woman into the jungle, while Lúcia and Enzo vaccinate the villagers with unexpected results.

3.o: In a bold bid for help, Lúcia challenges the cult leader to heal a nonbeliever. But the cure takes a surprising turn as the outside world presses in.

4.o: Curiosity lands Damião and Enzo in Aguazul's bizarre blue water as Lúcia enters the Chosen One's inner circle and attempts to control the message.

5.o: Angelina’s story comes to light while Lúcia takes her place at the healer’s side. Damião tries to make amends -- until everything goes sideways.

6.o: As Lúcia looks for mercy, Damião and Enzo face the ultimate test. Compounding the chaos, outsiders descend on Aguazul, clamoring for the cure.

1.o: Damião makes a shocking return and brings bad news with him. The sick, injured and dying literally flood into Aguazul (Blue Water) by the boatloads. Lucia stands alone when reporting what she witnessed and she is punished alone. Enzo makes a discovery in his new laboratory job and is willing to sacrifice Lucia, again. Eva appears and claims to want to report the truth of the Chosen One and his ability to heal.

2.t: Father, why have you forsaken me?
2.o: The Chosen One's twisted thinking makes him certain he can't heal Lucia, but Damião steps up to try and help her. Enzo's story becomes more convoluted, but not surprisingly, he still is more concerned about what he wants than who he hurts. The Serpent continues to play a larger role, Angelina grows weaker and the Chosen One becomes increasingly unstable.

3.o: The Chosen One continues to change his path, seemingly on whims, but he also ties himself to Lucia again. He orders her to find Angelina's replacement with the help of Enzo so that neither Lucia nor the Chosen One die. Eva is told that she will see the truth and the Chosen One changes the schedule for the children of the village so that Eva can witness what will happen. Santiago's background is shown and we better understand why he is hostile, cruel and angry all the time.

4.o: Angelina's replacement is found and delivered. Eva is betrayed as she sees the truth of Aguazul. The doctors continue to bicker and the three brothers bicker and condemn Cleuza. Zulmira is downtrodden as ever. At least the jaguar seems to know who is who and some horror elements are brought into this episode.

1.o: Staten Island, NY. The birth of Wu-Tang starts with a bang--literally.

2.o: With Divine on the sideline, Dennis and Bobby step up to handle his responsibilities.

3.o: The death of a friend sends Dennis spiraling and divides Staten Island.

4.t: All That I Got Is You
4.o: Bobby and Dennis find a new hustle to make some cream.

5.o: Divine returns home, but it doesn't feel the same.

6.o: A bird's eye view of Wu...

7.o: The Diggs family moves on but in different directions.

8.o: Industry Rule #4,080...

9.o: The Shaolin and the Wu Tang could be dangerous.

10.o: A mysterious tape makes the rounds of NYC. As people try to figure out who this group is Bobby and Dennis try to figure out how to handle Attila.

1.o: A new beginning is soured when a single decision turns Bobby’s life on its head.

2.o: Bobby goes all in on music while the rest of the Clan struggles with life in the projects.

3.o: The Clan becomes disillusioned with their paths as Bobby prepares to steer them in a new direction.

4.o: RZA makes a risky move to squash old beef.

5.o: Tension is thick as the Clan works together to build a home recording studio.

6.o: The Clan digs deep to make the perfect record to take the industry by storm.

7.o: With Protect Ya Neck in hand the Clan hustles to get it on airwaves and in stores by any means necessary.

8.o: The pressure is on when the Clan tells label executives to come see them perform at a legendary hip hop club on a night they aren’t booked.

9.o: RZA is torn between long money and quick cash as the Clan struggles with financial issues.

10.o: The Clan makes big moves for Wu domination.

1.o: Following six months in the wake of the season two finale, we find RZA and the Wu-Tang Clan have moved out of Staten Island to a mansion in the woods of New Jersey. Despite the massive success of their recently released album, they’ve only just begun.

2.o: As an album deadline nears, RZA must reconcile with his cousin Dirty by any means necessary. Dirty, however, takes refuge at Shurrie’s apartment. The friendship between Ghostface and Raekwon strengthens as they discuss a potential collaboration.

3.o: In our first allegorical movie of the season, we see Dirty take on the persona of “Dirt McGirt” in the theme of a 1970s blaxploitation film, as he finds inspiration for his first solo album, Return to the 36 Chambers.

4.o: The Wu-Tang Clan goes on a tour of the East Coast as we follow what happens between the shows on the tour bus. The guys quickly discover that living on a bus together might not be all fun, as they’re forced to deal with their problems face-to-face.

5.o: Following the completion of the tour, we see the paths of a few lesser known Wu-Tang members as they search for their individual voices amongst the crowd.

6.o: In our second allegorical movie of the season, we examine Raekwon's inspiration behind his first solo album, Only Built 4 Cuban Linx... through the lens of 90s gangster cinema.

7.o: In order to secure a deal for their new label, Divine must deliver on the promises he made to music executive Tommy Mottola. But upon returning to the Wu mansion, he learns that signing members and getting Dirty to feature on a song is easier said than done.

8.o: GZA takes on the persona of "The Genius" as he journeys through an alternate reality of New York City to unite the people using the music from his debut solo album, "Liquid Swords."

9.o: Ghostface reflects on the sacrifices of his past while dealing with the bittersweet outcome of his artistic success; RZA wants to take a different approach for the Clan's next album.

1.o: Dima who works as a judge has failed in her pregnancy attempts and she accidentally runs over a young boy. Ghassan helps the boy’s mother but he did not know that his wife is the one who hit him. The boy dies and Dima is devastated. Sa'ad helps Maya after she gets shot.

2.o: Ghassan tells Dima that the boy is not dead. Dima pays for the boy's expenses out of guilt. Maya learns that Sa'ad is a conman. It turns out that Ghassan is a womanizer, with many extramarital affairs.

3.o: Safaa tells Dima that she's nominated as Minister of Justice. Dima's brother, Hisham, is a fugitive from justice. Maya asks Bassam to look after her imprisoned sister Zina, as she killed her husband for cheating on her. Dima tries to convict Khalil for his illegal work.

4.o: After Maya's visit to Sa'ad, she decides to sell the stolen bags and take a percentage. While in prison, Zina reports Abla for insulting Nawal. Even though she is a prisoner, Abla enjoys authority in jail. Dima finds out about the boy’s paralysis.

5.o: Dima decides to try to get pregnant again. Maya accuses Sa'ad of stealing her money but it turns out that her friend, Salma, is the one who stole it. Bassam asks Zina to apologize to Abla so she won't get harmed.

6.o: Safaa warns Dima for sending after Khalil as he is involved in entering drugs into the country, even though she doesn't have evidence against him. Ghassan needs treatment for his mental illness. To take revenge, Salma reports Maya.

7.o: Dima learns about Natalie's death, and how her brother got her into the world of drugs, and she became paralyzed. Dima tells Ghassan about her brother's problem and he's upset that she hid it from him. Nabil harasses Dima. Sa'ad threatens Salma to get Maya out of police custody.

8.o: It turns out that Safaa utilizes her position in the ministry to smuggle money. Natalie's family refuses to accept Dima's condolences. Safaa's guilt prompts her to refuse to betray Dima with Ghassan again. Abla takes revenge on Zina.

9.o: Khalil asks Ghassan to help solve his problem with Dima and he agrees for his personal benefit. Sa'ad approaches Maya and tells her about his past suffering and she feels safe with him. Hisham returns to Dima.

10.o: Ghassan runs programs for his work with Khalil. It's revealed that the board is covering up for bribery and facilitation. Hisham enters the country with a fake passport.

11.o: Hisham ignores what Dima has told him and buys drugs. Nour seeks Ghassan's help after her parents force her to marry a rich man.

12.o: Hisham tells Dima his feelings for her. Ghassan hosts Nour and addresses her problem in order to get the audience to sympathize with her.

13.o: Deputy Safaa is assassinated in a bombing accident, and Dima is shocked after finding out. Ghassan speaks about the problem of underage marriage, and the heroine of the story is Nour. Nabil threatens Abla for defaming the prisoners.

14.o: Nour thanks Ghassan after when her mother starts treating her in a better way, but Ghassan wants what's more than thankful words. He sleeps with Nour and she regrets it. Zina is placed in solitary confinement.

15.o: After Khalil learns of Hisham's addiction and his evasion of a case, he threatens Dima, but she doesn't give in. Dima hands her brother over to the prosecution, much to Ghassan's shock. Sa'ad starts to teach Maya how to steal.

16.o: Ghassan suffers psychologically when his ex-wife takes his son away from him. Shady is sentenced. Dima is nominated as the Chief Justice. Maya steals Ghassan's phone, and Sa'ad blackmails him with scandalous videos of him with women.

17.o: Zina retaliates against Abla and tortures her. Dima suspects Ghassan after learning that he had been in constant contact with Safaa. Sa'ad asks Ghassan for money so he wouldn't expose him, and he learns from the videos that Ghassan was seeing Deputy Safaa.

18.o: Dima believes Ghassan despite lying to her. Sa'ad is agitated after Maya tells him that she is pregnant. The reason for his agitation is that he himself is an illegitimate child and he grew up with a hang-up towards having children.

19.o: Maya feels humiliated after Sa'ad suspects that he's not the father of the baby. Zakria attacks Ghassan again. Dima asks Nabil not to text her.

20.o: Bassam asks Maya to have an abortion so she wouldn't lose Sa'ad. Ghassan tries to contact Sa'ad to return his phone. Abla starts to treat Zina better.

21.o: Hisham's condition improves after entering the addiction clinic. Maya tries to leave the house but Sa'ad refuses and asks her to have an abortion. Sa'ad learns that Hala, the woman who took care of him as a child, has cancer and he helps her. Sa'ad asks Ghassan for more money.

22.o: Sa'ad forces Maya to have an abortion, and she leaves the house after stealing his money and taking Ghassan's phone. The doctor reassures Dima of the stability of her pregnancy. Hala visits Sa'ad in his house.

23.o: Khalil kills Abu Sulaiman before he blows a whistle on him. Nour learns that Ghassan took pictures of her with him, and she asks Wissam to help her return the phone.

24.o: Maya tells Dima about her husband's affairs, and she asks her to break her sister out of prison in exchange for not leaking the videos. Wissam watches Sa'ad and finds his house after Ghassan pays him to return the phone.

25.o: Ghassan locates Sa'ad’s house, but he learns that Maya had stolen the phone. Dima learns that she's married to a psychopath after seeing the videos, and she throws Ghassan out of the house and decides to take revenge on him.

26.o: Dima asks Nabil to help her break Zina out of jail. Nour commits suicide for her fear of the videos getting leaked.

27.o: Nabil agrees to smuggle Zina out of jail. Sa'ad collapses after Hala's death following her struggle with cancer. Sa'ad reaches Maya.

28.o: Dima learns from Susan, Ghassan's ex-wife, that he's an opportunist and harmful to others. Fou'ad rules Khalil out as a suspect after Ghassan’s intervention. Dima learns that Ghassan told Khalil that she had run over the boy just to blackmail her.

29.o: Ghassan kidnaps Maya and Sa'ad to return the phone to him to retrieve the phone, but Sarkis gets rid of the phone, and Ghassan disappears.

30.o: Dima informs the police of Ghassan's whereabouts after his attempt to kill Bassam, and Ghassan commits suicide. The wedding of Sa'ad and Maya takes place in the presence of the latter's sister and Dima.

1.o:
Tayf and Zeina share a passionate romance, but financial struggles threaten their hopes of building a life together.

The episode takes its title from "Kel El Qasayed" (2004), performed by Lebanese singer Marwan Khoury.

2.o:
Leila finds herself falling for Dr. Jalal, a much older married man, forcing her to confront the consequences of following her heart.

The episode takes its title from the song "Adaysh Helwi Hal Shaybe," performed by Lebanese singer Wadih El Safi.

Feeling neglected by his wife, Raef grows increasingly attached to Amal, the housekeeper who has become a caring presence in his life and his daughter's.

Psychiatrist Dina falls in love with Jawad, but their plans for marriage face an unexpected obstacle when his family background comes into question.

10.o: As the store gears up for the holidays, a series of unfortunate events — from a solar storm to an appearance by a former child star — causes chaos.

6.o: Didier and Bruno find themselves heading in opposite directions after signing with Epic. Issues in France cause them to bond once more.

1.o: When his verbal joust with presidential hopeful Éric Andréï goes viral, Stéphane finds himself in the limelight — and reluctantly running for office.

2.o: As Éric covertly tries to sabotage his campaign, Stéphane and his newly-formed team dodge old scandals and collect signatures to seal his candidacy.

3.o: Thanks to Mo’s security cameras, Stéphane identifies the arsonists. Later, they head to Corrèze, a rural town unlikely to appreciate team Blé’s vibe.

4.o: Éric tries to capitalize on Stéphane’s injury. Yasmine begins to suspect Will has an ulterior motive. Lamine finds himself in hot water.

5.o: After the email scandal, Stéphane and Corinne face off in a televised debate — but pointed questions and "surprise guests" dominate the evening.

6.o: With election day around the corner and Lamine on the run, Stéphane tries to salvage his marriage and his campaign. Will he succeed?

1.o: With no agenda, no party, no wife and a series of escalating threats, Stéphane and the team prepare for his upcoming inauguration at the Élysée Palace.

2.o: As Stéphane and Mo secretly handle a diplomatic incident, a royal visit is announced. Lamine inspires housing reform ahead of a celebratory garden party.

3.o: With his father in hospital and Marion in Guadeloupe, Stéphane attempts to strike a deal with a demanding Queen of Norway, making Corinne very unhappy.

4.o: As Stéphane and the team land in Guadeloupe in search of Marion, they are greeted by angry citizens. Back in Paris, Andréï prepares a military operation.

5.o: With his back against the wall, Stéphane prepares to make a big announcement. As he faces Cognard live on TV, protestors approach the presidential home.

6.o: As rioters storm the Élysée Palace, the team takes cover in a bunker. With Andréï desperate to take him down, can Stéphane survive his rival's coup?

1.o: A female jogger is found dead in Schuylkill River and Megan teams up with medical investigator Peter Dunlop to investigate her whereabouts before her murder. Meanwhile, Megan spends the day trying to solve a personal problem concerning her daughter's birthday.

2.o: When a young, interracial couple is found shot and killed inside their car in Fairmont Park, Dr. Megan Hunt promises the grieving parents that their daughter’s killer will be found. Detectives Bud Morris and Samantha Baker are ready to chalk the case up to a murder-suicide, but Megan and her team find evidence on the bodies that sends the case in an entirely different and shocking direction. Meanwhile, Peter advises Megan not to push too hard when it comes to reconnecting with her daughter, Lacey.

3.o: Megan is surprised to discover she has a connection to a woman found dead in a hotel room; Megan starts taking an interest in what is going on around her.

4.o: When a severed hand and foot turn up in a back alley, Megan and her team must literally piece the victim back together. Meanwhile, Megan's daughter, Lacey, gets her mother's reluctant permission to visit her at the office and film her at work as part of a video essay for Social Studies class. What Lacey learns in the process profoundly changes her view of her mother

5.o: Curtis questions Ethan's interest in the investigation of the mysterious death of a beautiful twin; Megan runs into resistance while investigating the death of a patient at the hospital where she used to work.

6.o: A magazine editor is found dead in her mansion; Megan confronts a suspect while at a social event with her mother; Ethan surprises Kate with his positive attitude.

7.o: A father is found stabbed to death in his home in the Philadelphia suburbs; Kate takes a consulting role in a case with Megan's ex-husband.

8.o: Megan and the team investigate when a Philadelphia homicide detective is killed in a hit-and-run; Megan turns to her mother (Joanna Cassidy) for help.

9.o: Megan suspects foul play when a young philanthropic socialite dies; the investigation is interrupted by Kate's personal life.

1.o: The investigation into a fatal car crash reveals the seedy underbelly of a perfect-looking neighborhood.

2.o: Many suspects emerge after a rich tycoon's new, young wife is shot during a deer hunt; Kate and Megan's relationship takes a turn for the worse.

3.o: When a young nanny is run down by a car and killed, the 5-year-old child she was watching is kidnapped; an interrogation goes awry.

4.o: A new investigation is opened up after a man assumed to be dead disappears off Ethan's exam table. When another body is found, it's the DNA evidence that leads to an eye-opening discovery.

5.o: After Peter rescues a woman from a house fire, Megan discovers another person in the house who died. Peter takes the discovery personally since he had no idea anyone else was in the house. A veteran arson investigator challenges Megan at each step in her investigation. When Megan complains to Kate the response she gets only intensifies the tension between the two women.

6.o: A champion equestrian is killed and potential drug use is suspected, but when Megan's daughter, who also rides, overhears details of the case, she leads the team to a clue and possibly the murderer.

7.o: When a popular 17-year-old high school student is found dead after a rave, the team must decipher various unknown drugs in his system and multiple bruises to figure out the cause of death. Meanwhile, Meghan is finally starting to date again after the divorce, but her ex-husband springs some shocking news on her and her daughter, causing tension at home.

8.o: A pharmaceutical rep is found dead in the Schuykill River, but when Megan Hunt and the team investigate, there's no blood found in her body. The team must locate the original crime scene to see if they can find the cause of death, but with suspects who have access to hundreds of unknown drugs, they may never know who or what killed her.

9.o: A murdered young woman's body turns up in place of a medical school cadaver during class, leaving Megan to rely on the aid of the star student to help solve the case.

10.o: When a recent lottery winner is found brutally murdered, everyone becomes a suspect.

11.o: Megan investigates the death of a bride on her wedding day; Ethan has a crush on the new girl, but she is interested in someone else.

12.o: An undercover cop is discovered murdered at a truck stop.

13.o: When a woman suspected of murdering her son is found innocent, Megan and the team try to identify the real killer; an overzealous reporter makes the investigation difficult by sensationalizing the case.

14.o: When the owner of a family owned and operated Italian restaurant turns up dead in the freezer, Dr. Hunt and the team take a closer look into family matters. Meanwhile, Peter must face his own haunted past.

15.o: After a car accident reveals a dead body in the trunk, the team is led to another body, giving the team two cases to solve; Megan is reconnected with an old acquaintance; Kate's job is threatened.

16.o: The parents of a seemingly perfect family are murdered; Curtis grapples with his new position; Megan's romantic life heats up.

17.o: When two young girls are in a tragic car accident, one is left in critical condition and the other is found dead at the scene. As Megan and her team investigate the case, however, they realize there has been an awful mistake. Not only was the wrong girl pronounced dead, but the car accident may not have been the actual cause of death.

18.o: When a city-wide outbreak of a mysterious and lethal virus occurs, even Megan and her team are at risk. In order to determine who and what caused this outbreak, CDC Officer Charlie Stafford takes over the investigation.

19.o: The team needs to quickly figure out how to treat the virus when more and more people are becoming ill and dying.

20.o: Megan comes face-to-face with a convicted serial killer she helped put away.

1.o: Part 1 of 2. In the Season 3 premiere, it's months after Peter's death and Megan returns to work, only to learn she's been teamed with a detective with whom she has a past history. She, Det. Sullivan and his rookie partner are up against a serial killer who targets young war veterans. The stakes become higher after she gets a call from the killer and is told he's holding her teenage daughter, Lacey, hostage.

2.o: In conclusion of the two-part Season 3 premiere, Megan discovers why the serial killer targeted war veterans, but must keep the information to herself or risk the life of her daughter, who is being held hostage by the assassin. Meanwhile, District Attorney Dan Russell has a run-in with Kate.

3.o: Megan and Tommy investigate a murder that appears on the surface to be a case of severe child abuse. But the girl's parents claim that their daughter was killed by the Devil after being possessed. The team must try to separate fact from fiction when the victim's mother begs Megan to help her stop the same thing from happening to their surviving daughter.

4.o: After his son is gunned down, a New York City mob boss threatens revenge, and when an early suspect is found dead, Megan and her team begin to believe the carnage has just begun.

5.o: After a murder suspect escapes from a prison-transport van, a witness in his trial turns up dead, and while Megan is investigating, the fugitive makes contact and tries to convince her that he's innocent and being framed.

6.o: Kate becomes involved with a man she met at a political event, but when a young Russian girl is found dead, she suspects that he may have something to do with the murder, and looks to Megan for help.

7.o: A murder victim's rabid neighbor bites Tommy, and after another rabies fatality, Megan calls on the new health commissioner to aid in their investigation.

8.o: When a young girl is found murdered, Megan has to put her personal doubt aside and help a blacked out Tommy, covered in blood, prove his innocence.

9.o: Gerry Roberts, in trial for defrauding his investors of a billion dollars, is kidnapped in front of the court house. The getaway car runs over a protestor and later, the team has to decide whether a video of Roberts being killed could have been faked by himself. Meanwhile, Megan gets closer to the truth about her father's death.

10.o: A schizophrenic teenage girl at a mental institution is found murdered. When Megan and Tommy interview a young patient named Darby, who seems extremely sane and lucid, she tells them that she saw the killer climb down from a heating vent in the ceiling, but most shocking of all -- he meant to kill her, not the actual victim. Could the killer be Dr. Malcolm, the ward director, who is obstructing their investigation.

11.o: When a plane crashes in Philadelphia due to a gunman opening fire while aloft, the entire team of Megan, Kate, Tommy, Adam, Curtis, Ethan, Riley and Stafford must go into disaster mode. Since the crash hits the city's main power grid, Megan must conduct autopsies on the victims during frequent blackouts, but then one of the bodies goes missing. Meanwhile, Tommy and Riley are in a serious car accident while trying to investigate.

12.o: An inmate violently escapes from a prison transport van and becomes a dangerous fugitive on the run in Philadelphia. Soon another man turns up dead - who's revealed to be a witness in the escaped prisoner's murder trial. Megan must continue to search for the truth in the original case when the accused murderer shows up and pleads with her that he is innocent and being framed.

13.o: Megan's father's exhumation uncovers more questions about what she always believed was a suicide, and her mother suggests she examine his patient files for clues about his death and that of a patient.

1.o: Convinced that her missing dad is in danger, Ida follows his trail to a town in the French Alps. A second disappearance brings an old case to light.

2.o: As Ida and Jaro look to old VHS tapes for clues, a suspicious Giovanna visits the Arcacia lab. Trouble brews ahead of the annual festival of Lévionna.

3.o: Gio and Ida find common ground as they explore hidden mountain terrain. Jaro and Roméo seek out a recluse who may know the truth about Roxane Vial.

4.o: Gio's theories create cracks in her marriage. Ida tries to make sense of DNA tests as Jaro and Roméo visit a psychiatric hospital in a state of chaos.

5.o: Jaro and Gio pair up after her son makes a disturbing discovery in the mines. Roméo is the guest of honor at a tense dinner with Hari and his mother.

6.o: As terror ensues inside the mine, a riot breaks out at the Arcacia lab. Gio desperately attempts to locate the group in the tunnel before it's too late.

4.o: تتحرك مشاعر "يونيس" تجاه رجل جديد، لكن "روثي" مقتنعة بأنه مولع بالفتيات الآسيويات. وتتحول علاقة عابرة لليلة واحدة عاشها "أندرو" إلى مصدر إزعاج بسبب تعلق الطرف الآخر به.

5.o: يعيد "أندرو" التواصل مع شخص كان يعرفه من أيام تردده على الكنيسة ويعلّمه عن حياة المثليين. وتتعرض "يونيس" للاستنزاف العاطفي على يد ربة عملها المتألقة المتسلطة "جاين".

6.o: يتعقد سعي "روثي" لشغل مقعد بمجلس إدارة شركتها للمحاماة بسبب التمييز الجنسي، ويضع "أندرو" خطة بديلة محكمة بعد فشله في طرد موظفة شركة "ديدستوك".

7.o: بعدما يواجه "أندرو" ضغطًا من "روثي" ليكون عرّاب طفلها، يتناول دواءً للتغلب على قلقه المزمن وميله المستمر إلى إرضاء الآخرين.

8.o: يعود الأشقاء "دانغ" إلى منزل العائلة في "بوسطن" ليتسنى لـ"روثي" إخبار والديهم بحملها، لكن التوقعات المرتفعة للغاية والعادات القديمة تعرقل لحظة كشف الخبر.
